summary.text: Justin Doyle is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 13B, in the November 3, 2026 general election; the August 11 Democratic primary for the seat was canceled.
A U.S. Navy veteran and retired postal worker who now drives a campus shuttle bus, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running on health care, education and the environment.

paragraphs.text: Justin Doyle served in the U.S. Navy from 1978 to 1981, graduated from Saint Cloud Technical High School and attended Saint John's University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong resident of Central Minnesota who has worked in agriculture, transportation and the U.S. Postal Service, from which he retired a few years ago.

He said he now drives an inter-campus bus serving the College of St. Benedict and St. John's University, and that he is a past or present member of five unions: UFCW, APWU, UTU, AFSCME and the Teamsters.
Doyle's campaign messages in the survey were universal health care, school funding that relies less on property taxes, and protection of Minnesota's lakes, streams, rivers and wetlands.
He said the Minnesota Senate District 13 DFL had endorsed him.
